title: VIBTOBIlab/scalemethyltobi pipeline parameters
description: ScaleBio single-cell DNA methylation analysis workflow

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet: the samples with their Tn5 barcodes and the fastq files of their libraries.
input.help_text: Comma-separated file with a header row. Required columns: `sample` and `libName`. Fastq columns: `fastq_1` (R1), `fastq_2` (R2), `index_1` (I1) and `index_2` (I2) of the library; give them in at least one row per library and add rows for more sequencing runs. Optional columns: `barcodes`, `threshold`, `resultDir`. Relative fastq paths are relative to the samplesheet. See docs/user-guide/samples-csv.md.

lib_structure.description: Library structure definition (.json); absolute path or relative to the references/ directory of the pipeline.
lib_structure.help_text: The default `lib.json` matches the ScaleBio Single-cell Methylation kit v1.0 and v1.1.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome: a pre-built genome by name (--genome) or your own genome.json (--genome_json).

genome.description: Pre-built reference genome (conf/genomes.config): hg38 or mm39.
genome.help_text: The ScaleBio genome archive is downloaded from --genomes_base and unpacked by the pipeline, in the work directory of the run. Give either --genome or --genome_json.

genome_json.description: Path to genome.json with the bwa-meth index and the genome annotation files, for genomes not in conf/genomes.config.
genome_json.help_text: Paths in genome.json are relative to the directory of genome.json. See docs/user-guide/reference-genomes.md.

genomes_base.description: Location (URL) of the pre-built genome archives.
genomes_base.help_text: Change it to use a mirror of the ScaleBio archives (an http(s) URL).

split_fastq.description: Split the demultiplexed fastq files by sample and Tn5 well for increased parallelization.

fastqc.description: Run FastQC on the input fastq files.

adapters.description: Adapter list used by FastQC (default: references/SciMETv2_Adapters.tsv of the pipeline).

min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality of the reads kept by sc_dedup.

calculate_ch.description: Calculate CH methylation (reports, parquet files and matrices).

ch_reads_threshold.description: Discard reads with a percentage of methylated CH above this threshold.

cell_calling_options.title: Cell-calling options
cell_calling_options.description: Options used to separate cells from background barcodes.

top_cell_percentile.description: Percentile of unique reads per barcode used as 'robust max'.

min_cell_ratio.description: Ratio between the unique reads of the top cells and the cell threshold.

min_uniq_count.description: Minimum unique reads to consider a barcode as a potential cell.

min_uniq_total.description: Minimum percentage of unique out of total reads of a cell.

max_uniq_total.description: Maximum percentage of unique out of total reads of a cell.

matrix_options.title: Matrix generation options
matrix_options.description: Matrices with the methylation signal per genome bin.

window_matrix_out.description: Generate matrices with the methylation signal per genome bin.

window_tile_size_cg.description: Bin size (bp) of the CG matrix; ignored when genomeTiles is set in genome.json.

window_tile_size_ch.description: Bin size (bp) of the CH matrix; ignored when genomeTilesCH is set in genome.json.

minimum_window_size.description: Minimum bin size (bp) after removing blacklisted regions.

output_options.title: Optional output files
output_options.description: Select which optional files are published.

cov_out.description: Per-cell methylation coverage in Bismark .cov format.

amethyst_out.description: Per-cell methylation coverage in Amethyst hdf5 format.

parquet_out.description: Methylation calls (parquet), needed to restart with --start_post_extraction.

bam_out.description: BAM files with all aligned reads.

multiqc_options.title: MultiQC options
multiqc_options.description: MultiQC report of the read QC, trimming and alignment statistics.

restart_options.title: Restart and merge options
restart_options.description: Restart from the outputs of previous runs or merge previous runs.

previous_outdir.description: Output directory of a previous run, used with --reporting_only or --start_post_extraction.

merged.description: Merge the previous runs listed in the resultDir column of samples.csv.

start_post_extraction.description: Start after methylation extraction (needs the parquet files of the previous run).

reporting_only.description: Only regenerate the metrics and the reports.

bam1_dir.description: alignments/bam directory of a previous run, merged with --bam2_dir.

bam2_dir.description: alignments/bam directory of a previous run, merged with --bam1_dir.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
